umbrella.name: AoE2WAR OS
umbrella.value_gate: Accurate aggregate provenance and per-domain source/physical/live separation

subordinate_os.name: Release OS
subordinate_os.responsibility: release execution, certification and release evidence
subordinate_os.value_gate: Exact protected deployed SHA + BUILD_ID, original financial unit continuity, certified rollback

subordinate_os.name: Documentation OS
subordinate_os.value_gate: Exact document registry/metadata/implementation baseline and strict DocsV2 PASS

subordinate_os.name: Storage OS
subordinate_os.responsibility: storage preservation, capacity, retention and restore evidence
subordinate_os.value_gate: Measured bytes preserved/restored, native reserve and no unapproved deletion

subordinate_os.name: Host OS
subordinate_os.responsibility: host maintenance, service inventory and native safeguards
subordinate_os.value_gate: Actual bounded systemd/host state with guarded maintenance and no financial restarts

subordinate_os.name: Recovery OS
subordinate_os.responsibility: bounded and tested failure recovery and rollback
subordinate_os.value_gate: Named immutable backup + independently proved restoration and reversible scope

subordinate_os.name: Workspace OS
subordinate_os.value_gate: Source/worktree ownership, clean/dirty provenance and approved non-destructive changes

subordinate_os.name: Speed OS
subordinate_os.value_gate: Source-bound actual performance cohorts and budget with stable repeatable evidence

subordinate_os.name: Replay Truth OS
subordinate_os.value_gate: Replay/parser provenance, authenticated winner adjudication and unknown-vs-verified truth

subordinate_os.name: Central Command OS
subordinate_os.responsibility: human owner delegated queue, evidence, review, priority and six-lane dispatch; never doubles as the runtime agent scheduler
subordinate_os.value_gate: Traceable P0-P3 owner-reviewed dispatch decisions with no invented agent heartbeat

subordinate_os.name: Deployment OS
subordinate_os.responsibility: versioned component scope admission and release-phase coordination; Release OS remains actual executor
subordinate_os.value_gate: Owner-consented source-pinned 3031 isolation, reversible nginx route, G live witness

subordinate_os.name: Orchestra OS
subordinate_os.responsibility: workflow DAG planning, leases and handoffs; reuse Central queue, don't create new release authority
subordinate_os.value_gate: Real lease/claim DAG and fencing provenance rather than issue-comment scheduler

subordinate_os.name: Agent OS
subordinate_os.responsibility: bounded single worker lifecycle, tools, state, sandbox, permissions, verification and expense budgets
subordinate_os.value_gate: One bounded worker with authenticated tool/permission/budget/receipt lifecycle

subordinate_os.name: Swarm OS
subordinate_os.responsibility: coordinated fleet scheduling, isolation and adversarial reviews with measured 6-to-1000 promotion
subordinate_os.value_gate: Measured concurrent worker and reviewer throughput with rollback/containment gates

subordinate_os.name: WoloChain OS
subordinate_os.responsibility: read-only chain health, RPC/consensus/indexer/bridge lineage and independently proven mainnet reconciliation; custody remains separate
subordinate_os.value_gate: Real mainnet RPC/consensus/indexer evidence, no custody authority

subordinate_os.name: Code Health OS
subordinate_os.responsibility: bounded source inventory and hashed diagnostic receipts; no independent release or automatic refactor authority
subordinate_os.value_gate: Executed source scan plus hashed receipts and independently reviewed interpretation

supervisory_roles.name: System Shepherd
supervisory_roles.note: Not yet independently proven autonomous or independently registered as an OS.

supervisory_roles.name: System Composer / Kingdom Composer
supervisory_roles.responsibility: Compose only Central-approved goals into versioned DAGs, owner-reviewed task/edge/lease plans, budgets, conflict checks and immutable simulation receipts; Orchestra alone schedules approved tasks.
cannot: set Central priority or replace queue #984
activate, promote or roll back production
assert a heartbeat from source, CI or visuals
supervisory_roles.value_gate: At least one independently reviewed workflow plan with exact source refs, acyclic blocking edges, proven collision detection and fewer duplicate handoffs; throughput and intervention changes measured.

unreconciled_named_capabilities.name: Council OS

unreconciled_named_capabilities.name: Loop Engine / Loop OS

unreconciled_named_capabilities.name: Graph / Provenance OS
unreconciled_named_capabilities.evidence: Dependency/lineage model spans existing owner domains; standalone OS unsupported

counts.count_scope: 15 subordinate identities (10 source-present + 5 draft/proposed), 1 umbrella; 3 non-OS roles (Doctor, Shepherd, Composer). No verified live-worker census.

rules: This is a proposed normalized roster, not a census of every branded module across all AoE2WAR repositories.
OS classification requires unique owner, authority, executable contract, evidence, recovery and measured value.
Do not count Doctor or Shepherd as OSs. Do not count umbrella as its own subordinate OS.
Public system-agent cards are source projections; unknown worker activity is not running.
New systems reuse existing code, storage and receipts; no deletion/replacement just to rename.
Website deployment P0 never waits for this P3 registry. Wolo financial authority remains separate.
Code Health has distinct existing source contract; add it to planning roster without claiming separate daemon
Performance is an alias of Speed, Renaissance integration facet, Council composite diagnostic, Loop and Graph engines are cross-cutting rather than OS
16 named planning identities includes umbrella; verified live estate remains UNKNOWN; never present 16 as certified operational count
System Composer is a proposed Orchestra OS role; never a subordinate OS or autonomous production authority.
Seven visual modes share one evidence projection. Never promote simulation/polling/animation to observed live telemetry.
P3 visual and composition planning cannot block F #1083 P0 website #1061 or alter Deployment OS #1088.

identity_semantics.id: immutable short key; never reuse after rename

identity_semantics.umbrella: distinct navigation/integration identity but not subordinate
identity_semantics.catalog_count: identity count including source-only drafts; never worker count
identity_semantics.physical: UNKNOWN until authenticated actual process/host evidence
